title: Second Book of the Dagger Hand
summary: Builds on the first drills with qi-edged cuts and thrusts, linking the dagger to steady footwork.

title: Treatise on Binding and Releasing the Wrist
summary: Teaches the locks, hooks and releases that hold an opponent's weapon hand with a dagger.

title: Counters Against the Longer Blade
summary: Shows how a dagger fighter slips inside a sword or spear and counters with qi-sharpened thrusts.

title: Course in the Close Line
summary: Trains a student to hold the inside line of an exchange with short strokes and a qi-braced guard.

title: Canon of the Ribs and Seams
summary: Names the weak lines of the body and of armor and teaches the thrusts that find them.

title: Studies in Qi-Edged Cutting for the Dagger
summary: Teaches the thin qi film on the edge and the draw cuts that make use of it.

title: The Disarming Workbook
summary: Sets out the twists, hooks and taps that strip a weapon from the hand using a dagger.

title: Principles of the Slip and Stab
summary: Teaches the slip, the pivot and the counter stab that follow an opponent's first motion.

title: Manual of the Double Thrust
summary: Drills the paired thrust with qi along the point, one stab following the next before the guard resets.

title: The Pulse-Reading Primer for the Short Blade
summary: Teaches the dagger fighter to read an opponent's motion through contact with steel and qi.
